---
title: "Testing Fixation & Overnight Fixation on CAR T cells"
author: "Cyrus Martinian"
date: 2026-07-27
toc: TRUE
theme: darkly
---
CAR T cell sample was obtained from Rediet Mulatu. Cells were aliquoted into unfixed vs. fixed samples. 

5 uL of TruStain FcX was added to each sample, and samples were allowed to incubate in the fridge for at least 5 minutes. 

While samples were incubating, 4% PFA fixative was obtained and diluted to 0.4% (10 uL of PFA and 90 uL of PBS were added to an eppendorf tube and mixed well). 

After incubation with FcX, each tube (containing 100 uL of cell solution) was split into 2 50 uL aliquots. These 4 samples were labled "unstained, unstained-fixed, 29C, 29C-fixed". 50 uL of the 0.4% PFA solution was added to the two samples labled for fixation, and these samples were incubated in the fridge for 20 minutes. 

While samples were fixed, the antibody cocktail was prepared according to the following table:

![](/images/fullpanel.png)

After fixation incubation, 500 uL of PBS was added to both samples containing fixative and these samples wee centrifuged at 300 xg for 5 minutes. Supernatent was discarded and samples were resuspended in 50 uL of PBS to match unfixed samples. 

Antibody cocktail was added to the appropriate samples & allowed to incubate overnight.
